description: I am Arjun P, a Civil Engineering student at CET. I am interested in science, technology, innovation, problem-solving, and space-related projects. I am looking for enthusiastic and creative teammates who are passionate about learning and working together. We welcome members with skills in programming, GIS, remote sensing, data analysis, research, design, and presentation. Let's collaborate and create innovative solutions!
summary:
Our project, "Abandoned but Not Forgotten", focuses on NASA's discarded and inactive equipment left on the Moon and Mars during space exploration missions. The project aims to tell the stories behind these machines, including lunar landers, rovers, scientific instruments and other space technology.

We explore why this equipment was left behind, what its original purpose was, and how it contributed to scientific discoveries. Through photographs, storytelling, mission timelines and educational information, our project makes space exploration easier and more interesting for students and young space enthusiasts.

This project highlights the achievements of NASA scientists and engineers and explains the importance of their discoveries. It also encourages students to learn about astronomy, planetary science, robotics and engineering.

Our main goal is to show that even when a space mission ends, its achievements and scientific contributions are never forgotten.
